name: Misty forest morning
one_line: Tall pines fading into pale green mist.
look_words: A pine forest just after dawn. Moss greens and grey-blue trunks, a soft earth path, ferns and fallen logs, everything fading into pale green-grey mist in layers so that only the nearest trees are clear. Light is cool and low with a few soft shafts between trunks; there are no hard shadows. Shapes are tall verticals and soft mounds. The player wears mustard yellow, the warmest thing in the forest. Pale cream glows and a clear aqua mark what to find and where to go; red means harm. Motion is slow: drifting mist, falling needles, a deer lifting its head. Avoid bright greens, clear blue sky, hard sunlight, bloom and busy undergrowth that hides the path.

palette.name: forest mist
palette.notes: The fog is the look (0.85): it hides the distance and makes near things matter. Sun is weak, ambient does most of the lighting.

look_wish: soft painterly shading with haze, or none

upgrade.why: low patchy mist that lies between the trunks instead of a flat fog wall

music.mood: slow, breathy pads and a low clarinet

sound_feel: damp and soft; drips, birdsong far off, twigs, footsteps on moss
